choices.text: Pull the codes and run a full diagnostic before giving any time estimate.
Try the most likely fix first, a clogged fuel filter, and get him moving if it works.
Ask Pao, who has seen this engine family a lot, what he would check first.

response.text: A fruit hauler limps into your Stockton shop with a check-engine light and low power. The driver has peaches due in Los Angeles by evening. Brenda has already promised him a quick look.
response.title: Truck down on the 99
